_doc: Answers a blog got wrong where the grid alone could not say which fix is right, settled by reading the clue's wordplay. Keyed by blog (a fetch_wp_blog.BLOGS name), then post_id, then "<number> <direction>". tools/times_grids.py applies these before rebuilding the grid and records each as a correction on the grid row.

17 across.wordplay: SWEEPS (cleans up) + TAKE (win); the blog gave SWEEPS

8 down.wordplay: troublemakers (8); the blog dropped the S
anagram of MERRY E NUNS; the blog typed NURSEYMEN

20 across.wordplay: WINDOWS (kind of software) + HOPPER (person jumping), browser (6,7)

1 down.wordplay: tidying up with a sucker (6,8); the blog gave VACUUM CLEANER

6 down.wordplay: be frustrated (4,4,4,3); the blog gave TEAR OUT ONE'S HAIR

7 down.wordplay: tied up; TETTERED is no word

5 down.wordplay: anagram of SOME GO DECIDE; the blog typed GEODOSIC

25 across.wordplay: OP (work) in SPECIAL* (building) (9); the blog wrote ESPICOPAL, so 17 down DUMPLING could not cross it

14 down.wordplay: shoe (8); the blog wrote MOCASSIN, so 21 across DIALOGUE could not cross it
